title: General Hospital Spoilers, Thursday, July 30: Anna and Jason Reunite While Deception Drama Heats Up. - NewsBreak
text:
By Jamie White ,
5 hours ago General Hospital spoilers for Thursday, July 30 reveal Anna Devane ( Finola Hughes ) has another reunion. Meanwhile, Deception drama ramps up. Plus, Brook Lynn Quartermaine ( Amanda Setton ) isn’t messing around. Here’s what you need to know.
Key Highlights Anna and Jason share their recent experiences. Lucy and Tracy seem to be preparing for war. Brook Lynn makes a promise to Michael.
Reunited First, General Hospital spoilers reveal Jason Morgan’s ( Steve Burton ) return tour continues. This time, he will check in with Anna. They have been both through it since their last meeting, and now the pair will compare notes. Or share pain. Whatever you prefer. He’ll acknowledge everything they’ve been through, and we imagine she’ll have tons of questions for him. Although, we doubt any of them will be related to the pier shooting Jason took the blame for. After her talk with Dante Falconeri ( Dominic Zamprogna ), she seemed to have a clue as to what was going on and was going to drop the issue for everyone’s sake.
However, she has been hallucinating Peter August ( Wes Ramsey ), who seems to want her focus on Britt Westbourne ( Kelly Thiebaud ). So, we do believe she’ll try to get some information on her, as Jason has been close to her. And Jason might just give her something, at least. They did have an understanding between each other and he would have no reason to consider these questions are the result of anything but a desire to understand everything that happened. Certainly, he won’t believe they’re coming from a dead guy.
It’s on? As for Tracy Quartermaine ( Jane Elliot ), she apparently has plans for Lucy Coe ( Lynn Herring ). We’re not surprised, given how Lucy got those shares from her granddaughter. She’ll talk about how torturing Lucy is just a perk.
It seems Lucy has plans of her own. Her daughter is back and she’ll want to know why she’s returned to town. We’ll see if Lucy wants Serena Baldwin ( Kelly Kruger ) to be part of the company and maybe help Lucy gain more control over it.
Not a chance Finally, following his visit with Willow Tait ( Katelyn MacMullen ), General Hospital spoilers indicate Michael Corinthos ( Rory Gibson ) has concerns about Brook Lynn and Harrison Chase ( Josh Swickard ). The pair will meet up and Brook Lynn will swear Willow won’t get her claws into Chase. So, it’s clear Michael thinks joint custody isn’t all Willow wants in life. Especially since everyone’s finding out she and Drew Cain ( Cameron Mathison ) are divorcing. Both Brook Lynn and Michael have plotted to end Chase and Willow’s friendship on their own, so we see these two coming up with a plan together. And Willow might just regret pushing her luck. As they say, “Pride goes before the fall,” and Willow is full of it right now.
